description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail, but don't critically fail, a saving throw against an effect with the visual trait.

You performatively throw a disinterested glance at danger before looking away. The triggering effect is suppressed until the beginning of your next turn, at which point you melodramatically return your attention to it. If you're no longer susceptible to the effect—for example, if you can no longer see its source or are no longer within range—you remain unaffected. Otherwise, you're immediately affected as if you'd critically failed at the triggering save.
